title: pharn-ci Report v1
description: Machine-readable output of pharn-ci. This schema is the source of truth: markdown and CLI text are renderings of this object. Within schemaVersion "1" fields are never removed or retyped; new optional fields may only be added by updating this file.

verdict.description: "fail" if any message has level "error", else "warn" if any has level "warn", else "pass".

diffCoverage.description: Coverage of lines added in the diff. null when it could not be computed (no coverage file, or no diff base); a message explains why.

files.description: Agent setup files tracked in the repo, sorted by path.

summary.description: Optional. Counts and tools derived from files; consumers can recompute it.

percent.description: Percentage rounded to 2 decimals. null when there are no coverable lines. diffCoverage.percent is rounded down instead when rounding up would reach a threshold the coverage does not meet (15,999 of 20,000 lines at threshold 80 is 79.99, not 80).

format.description: Optional. The coverage format the report was read as, whether named by the user or detected from the file.

threshold.description: Minimum required percent (inclusive), compared exactly against coveredLines / coverableLines, not against the rounded percent. null when no threshold is configured. 0 gates no percent (a DIFF_COVERAGE_UNGATED message says so) but, like any threshold, makes unmeasurable coverage an error.

coverableLines.description: Added lines that the coverage report knows about. Added lines absent from the coverage report (comments, types, untested files) are excluded.

files.description: Files with at least one coverable added line, sorted by path.

excludedFiles.description: Changed files left out of diff coverage because an exclusion pattern (coverage.exclude, --exclude or the Action's exclude input) matches their path. Repo-relative paths with forward slashes, sorted by path. Present only when at least one changed file was excluded; such files count nowhere else in diffCoverage.

uncoveredLines.description: 1-based line numbers in the new file, ascending.

kind.description: Known kinds: claude-md, agents-md, claude-settings, claude-settings-local, claude-skill, claude-hook, claude-agent, claude-command, cursor-rules, copilot-instructions, mcp-config, claude-local-md, gemini-md, copilot-instructions-scoped, copilot-agents, copilot-prompts, cursor-mcp, vscode-mcp, codex-config, windsurf-rules, cline-rules, claude-rule, aider-config, conventions-md, continue-rules, roo-rules, amazonq-rules, junie-guidelines, zed-rules, augment-rules, kiro-steering, goosehints, opencode-config, gemini-settings. New kinds may be added within v1; consumers must tolerate unknown kinds.

byKind.description: Number of agent setup files per kind, derived from files. Lists only the kinds that are present.

tools.description: Distinct agent tools that read the present kinds, derived from files and sorted. Drawn from a fixed list. Known tools: claude-code, cursor, copilot, codex, gemini, windsurf, cline, mcp, aider, amazon-q, amp, augment, continue, goose, jules, junie, kiro, opencode, roo, zed. New tools may be added within v1; consumers must tolerate unknown tools.

code.description: Stable identifier; branch on this, never on text. Known codes: DIFF_COVERAGE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, DIFF_COVERAGE_UNGATED, NO_COVERABLE_CHANGES, COVERAGE_FILE_MISSING, COVERAGE_FILE_EMPTY, COVERAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED, DIFF_UNAVAILABLE, NO_AGENT_SETUP_FILES. New codes may be added within v1; consumers must tolerate unknown codes. DIFF_COVERAGE_UNGATED is level info: diff coverage was measured (coverableLines > 0) but no threshold above 0 gates it. NO_AGENT_SETUP_FILES is level info, or error when the agent setup requirement (setup.require, require-agent-setup) is on. COVERAGE_PATHS_UNMATCHED (none of the coverage report's file paths is a tracked repo file, so diff coverage was not computed; error with a threshold, warn without) and COVERAGE_PATHS_PARTIALLY_UNMATCHED (info: some coverage paths are not tracked files) were added after 0.1.0.
